_meta.notes:
SETUP CHECKLIST — replace all REPLACE_WITH_ placeholders before activating:
1. Gmail OAuth2 credential ID
2. Google Sheets credential ID + Sheet ID
3. Twilio credential ID + your Twilio phone number
4. Set 'To' address in both Gmail nodes (alerts + client notification)
5. Update SMS message template with real business name and phone
6. Verify Google Guaranteed email sender address matches your client's actual emails
7. Optional: replace Gmail Trigger with Pub/Sub webhook for instant delivery
